summary: Build 11 root package.json fix verified end-to-end. /app/package.json is valid JSON with private:true and contains exactly the required delegating scripts (verify, audit:banned-language, audit:sample-ads, audit:secrets, audit:navigation, audit:monetization — plus test/typecheck/typecheck:backend). Each script delegates via `cd vaultpop && pnpm run <same>` — no echo/no-op stubs. Running individual audits from /app produced the exact expected pass messages. `pnpm run verify` from /app completed with exit 0, node test summary 'tests 51 / pass 51 / fail 0', and all five audit pass lines. Git shows commit df650613 on top of 2598d2ec touching ONLY package.json (new, +17 lines) and .gitignore (+4 lines) — no app code/IDs/metadata modified. Frontend smoke: https://vaultpop-premium.preview.emergentagent.com/ renders the VaultPop home screen; /shop renders the Vault Supply shop screen — Metro/Expo workspace resolution unaffected by the new root package.json.
critical_code_review_comments: Root /app/package.json is intentionally a thin delegator (no dependencies, no lockfile) so it will not create a competing node_modules at /app that could break Metro's workspace resolution — correct approach.
.gitignore correctly ignores /yarn.lock and .pnpm-store/ at the repo root to prevent CI/test artifacts from creating a rogue root lockfile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GitHub-save blocker fix verified. Root package.json delegates to /app/vaultpop suite. To run audits/verify from /app, always prepend PATH shim: `export PATH=/tmp/bin:/tmp/node-v24.4.1-linux-arm64/bin:$PATH` (system node is v20; pnpm 11 requires >=22). Do NOT run npm/yarn install at /app root — it would create a lockfile that breaks Metro's workspace resolution for the ./frontend mirror. Previous iteration_4 admin-ops features remain untested here (out of scope).
rca_of_issue: Original blocker: commit 2598d2ec had no /app/package.json, so the promised verify/audit commands could not run from repo clone root. Fix in commit df650613 adds a private root package.json whose scripts each `cd vaultpop && pnpm run <same>` — real delegation to the intact canonical suite in /app/vaultpop. Verification confirmed: 5/5 audits pass with exact expected messages, 51/51 node tests pass, pnpm run verify exits 0, and frontend web preview still renders correctly (no Metro workspace breakage).
